verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page documents Privacy Mode. Any user, free or Pro, can enable it, or a team or enterprise admin can enforce it, and new team members inherit it. It states that "When enabled, we will not train on your data," which directly delivers a training opt-out for the Cursor platform that Bugbot is part of. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Privacy Mode covers Bugbot's PR-review data specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Privacy Mode can be enabled in settings or by a team or enterprise admin. Privacy Mode is available to anyone (free or Pro). New team members inherit the team's Privacy Mode settings. When enabled, we will not train on your data.
